methods.title: GRAFT-Net: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Network for Textual and Knowledge Base Question Answering
methods.notes: Graph expansion and graph-based evidence composition.

methods.title: PullNet: Open Domain Question Answering with Iterative Retrieval on Knowledge Bases and Text
methods.notes: Iteratively expands a question-specific graph.

methods.title: Multi-hop Reading Comprehension through Question Decomposition and Rescoring
methods.notes: Decomposes compositional questions into simpler subquestions and globally rescores decompositions.

methods.title: Dynamically Fused Graph Network for Multi-hop Reasoning
methods.notes: Builds and traverses an entity graph over scattered text evidence.

methods.title: Learning to Retrieve Reasoning Paths over Wikipedia Graph for Question Answering
methods.notes: Sequentially retrieves evidence paragraphs conditioned on earlier hops.

methods.title: Unsupervised Question Decomposition for Question Answering
methods.notes: Learns one-to-many decomposition without manually labeled decompositions and recomposes subanswers.

methods.title: Scalable Multi-Hop Relational Reasoning for Knowledge-Aware Question Answering
methods.notes: Performs multi-hop relational reasoning over extracted knowledge-graph subgraphs.

methods.title: Hierarchical Graph Network for Multi-hop Question Answering
methods.notes: Represents question paragraphs sentences and entities at multiple graph granularities.

methods.title: Leveraging Passage Retrieval with Generative Models for Open Domain Question Answering
methods.notes: Fusion-in-decoder reader over retrieved passages.

methods.title: Answering Complex Open-Domain Questions with Multi-Hop Dense Retrieval
methods.notes: Dense retriever conditions each hop on previously retrieved evidence without requiring corpus-specific links.

methods.title: Baleen: Robust Multi-Hop Reasoning at Scale via Condensed Retrieval
methods.notes: Condenses retrieved evidence between hops to control search and context growth.

methods.title: Decomposing Complex Questions Makes Multi-Hop QA Easier and More Interpretable
methods.notes: Uses relation extraction reader and comparison stages to form a decomposed evidence path.

methods.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
methods.notes: Interleaves natural-language reasoning traces with environment actions such as Wikipedia lookup; primary target follows the earliest active retrieval event.

methods.title: Interleaving Retrieval with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Knowledge-Intensive Multi-Step Questions
methods.notes: Interleaves generated reasoning with retrieval.

methods.title: Active Retrieval Augmented Generation
methods.notes: Retrieval is triggered by generation uncertainty; verify the precise multi-hop scope before using it for a focused comparison.

methods.title: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve Generate and Critique through Self-Reflection
methods.notes: Joint retrieval generation and critique policy; primary target follows the earliest active retrieval event.

methods.title: RAPTOR: Recursive Abstractive Processing for Tree-Organized Retrieval
methods.notes: Changes retrieval granularity and context organization.

methods.title: Corrective Retrieval Augmented Generation
methods.notes: Evaluates retrieved context and may trigger web search plus decomposition and recomposition.

methods.title: Adaptive-RAG: Learning to Adapt Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models through Question Complexity
methods.notes: Selects no-retrieval single-step or iterative retrieval strategies from predicted query complexity; primary target follows the earliest active retrieval event.

methods.title: End-to-End Beam Retrieval for Multi-Hop Question Answering
methods.notes: Maintains multiple partial evidence hypotheses to reduce early-hop search errors.

methods.title: From Local to Global: A Graph RAG Approach to Query-Focused Summarization
methods.notes: Builds an entity graph and community summaries to expose local and global corpus evidence.

methods.title: HippoRAG: Neurobiologically Inspired Long-Term Memory for Large Language Models
methods.notes: Uses a graph-based memory index and personalized PageRank for efficient multi-hop retrieval.

methods.title: EfficientRAG: Efficient Retriever for Multi-Hop Question Answering
methods.notes: Decomposes a multi-hop question while pruning irrelevant subquestions and documents during retrieval.

methods.title: Is ChatGPT Good at Search? Investigating Large Language Models as Re-Ranking Agents
methods.notes: Introduces listwise LLM reranking; included as a foundational selector used in multi-hop RAG comparisons.

methods.title: RankZephyr: Effective and Robust Zero-Shot Listwise Reranking is a Breeze!
methods.notes: Open listwise reranker with order and candidate-count robustness checks.

methods.title: Fine-Tuning LLaMA for Multi-Stage Text Retrieval
methods.notes: Studies an LLM retriever and pointwise reranker; the audit codes the reranking intervention.

methods.title: RECOMP: Improving Retrieval-Augmented LMs with Context Compression and Selective Augmentation
methods.notes: Compresses retrieved context and selectively suppresses augmentation when it is not useful.

methods.title: LLMLingua-2: Data Distillation for Efficient and Faithful Task-Agnostic Prompt Compression
methods.notes: Token-level compression under an explicit budget; downstream answer preservation is not coded as causal faithfulness.

methods.title: RankRAG: Unifying Context Ranking with Retrieval-Augmented Generation in LLMs
methods.notes: Jointly instruction-tunes context ranking and answer generation; primary target is candidate preservation.

methods.title: Shifting from Ranking to Set Selection for Retrieval Augmented Generation
methods.notes: Selects a complementary passage set against explicit information requirements rather than scoring passages independently.

methods.title: Aligning Retrieval with Reader Needs: Reader-Centered Passage Selection for Open-Domain Question Answering
methods.notes: Reranks and clusters passages using reader predictions; answer-distribution clustering can couple selection and reader behavior.

methods.title: PRCA: Fitting Black-Box Large Language Models for Retrieval Question Answering via Pluggable Reward-Driven Contextual Adapter
methods.notes: Refines retrieved information between retriever and generator with a reward-driven contextual adapter.

methods.title: Found in the Middle: Calibrating Positional Attention Bias Improves Long Context Utilization
methods.notes: Calibrates position-biased attention so relevant middle context remains accessible.

methods.title: Long-Context LLMs Meet RAG: Overcoming Challenges for Long Inputs in RAG
methods.notes: Studies placement and retrieval ordering under long inputs; fixed-set ordering effects are coded separately from membership.

methods.title: xRAG: Extreme Context Compression for Retrieval-Augmented Generation with One Token
methods.notes: Maps a retrieved document embedding into one language-model token; primary target is context exposure under an extreme token budget.

methods.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
methods.notes: Controlled analysis that varies the location of relevant information while holding content fixed.

methods.title: KG-FiD: Infusing Knowledge Graph in Fusion-in-Decoder for Open-Domain Question Answering
methods.notes: Injects graph structure into passage filtering and Fusion-in-Decoder; fusion is coded primary for the reviewed mechanism.

methods.title: ReaRev: Adaptive Reasoning for Question Answering over Knowledge Graphs
methods.notes: Uses reason-and-revise instruction execution over a question-specific graph.

methods.title: Improving Multi-hop Knowledge Base Question Answering by Learning Intermediate Supervision Signals
methods.notes: Teacher-student intermediate supervision stabilizes multi-hop graph reasoning.

methods.title: GreaseLM: Graph Reasoning Enhanced Language Models for Question Answering
methods.notes: Couples graph propagation with language-model representations for cross-evidence composition.

methods.title: RARR: Researching and Revising What Language Models Say, Using Language Models
methods.notes: Retrieves evidence and revises generated text while preserving as much original content as possible.

methods.title: Verify-and-Edit: A Knowledge-Enhanced Chain-of-Thought Framework
methods.notes: Verifies factual claims in a reasoning chain with retrieved knowledge before editing.

methods.title: Enabling Large Language Models to Generate Text with Citations
methods.notes: Defines automatic citation correctness and completeness evaluation; citation overlap is not treated as causal evidence use.

methods.title: CofCA: A Step-Wise Counterfactual Multi-hop QA Benchmark
methods.notes: Uses factual and counterfactual multi-step items to test whether answers and intermediate chains follow supplied evidence.

methods.title: Self-Checker: Plug-and-Play Modules for Fact-Checking with Large Language Models
methods.notes: Decomposes generated text into claims and retrieves evidence for verification.

methods.title: CRITIC: Large Language Models Can Self-Correct with Tool-Interactive Critiquing
methods.notes: Uses external tools to critique and revise model outputs; tool feedback is distinguished from causal deletion tests.

methods.title: Beyond Correctness: Rewarding Faithful Reasoning in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
methods.notes: Introduces information-think think-answer and think-search faithfulness rewards for search agents.

methods.title: Search-R1: Training LLMs to Reason and Leverage Search Engines with Reinforcement Learning
methods.notes: Trains multi-turn reasoning and search with reinforcement learning; primary target is evidence acquisition.

methods.title: DeepRAG: Thinking to Retrieve Step by Step for Large Language Models
methods.notes: Learns a retrieve-or-reason policy; included through one discretionary recency slot.

methods.title: RAG-Gym: Optimizing Reasoning and Search Agents with Process Supervision
methods.notes: Optimizes search trajectories with process supervision; included through one discretionary process-supervision slot.

benchmarks.name: HotpotQA
benchmarks.caveat: Supporting-fact annotations are a proxy rather than a complete latent chain.

benchmarks.name: 2WikiMultiHopQA
benchmarks.caveat: Construction and evidence provenance should be considered in cross-dataset comparisons.

benchmarks.name: HoVer
benchmarks.caveat: The claim-verification setting is not answer extraction and includes multi-sentence claims at higher hop counts.

benchmarks.name: KILT: a Benchmark for Knowledge Intensive Language Tasks
MuSiQue: Multihop Questions via Single-hop Question Composition
benchmarks.caveat: Reported metrics depend on the retrieval setting and distractor construction.

benchmarks.name: QASC
benchmarks.caveat: Two annotated facts do not eliminate the need for open-corpus retrieval or commonsense composition.
